method: Nine fresh stock L0 cars on a flat road in separated lanes. Seed 100 km/h once after settling; eight primary profiles start in gear index 0 and a ninth production discriminator starts in gear index 2. Automatic gearbox remains active. Steer from 0.5 to 4.5 seconds, observe for 6 seconds, requested throttle held throughout. Real RCCP OverrideInputs/Update propagation and FormulaSteering remain active. Fixed-step summaries and 0.1-second traces. Wheel order FL, FR, RL, RR; slips are raw WheelHit values, avoiding RCCP slip getters that mutate filters. Diagnostic completion does not imply handling passed.
tcsCandidate: Production TCSIntensity is already the documented maximum 1 ([Range(0,1)]); the seventh case changes ESP to off instead.
